maskThreshold.description: Voxels strictly above this intensity are treated as vessel foreground

fillHoles.description: Fill 6-connected interior cavities inside vessels before skeletonisation

minComponentVoxels.description: Minimum 26-connected vessel component size in voxels (0 keeps all)

minSpurLengthMm.description: Iteratively prune terminal spurs shorter than this length in mm (0 disables)

pruneContainedSpurs.description: Also prune terminal spurs whose tip stays within the parent junction inscribed sphere

minIsolatedLengthMm.description: Minimum length in mm for standalone endpoint-to-endpoint segments (0 keeps all)

smoothIterations.description: Pinned Taubin centerline smoothing iterations (0 keeps raw voxel polylines)
